response.sql: WITH per_player AS (SELECT b.player_id, p.bats, AVG(b.double) AS average_doubles FROM batting_postseason AS b JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = b.player_id GROUP BY b.player_id, p.bats), indexed AS (SELECT player_id, bats, average_doubles, average_doubles / (SELECT AVG(average_doubles) FROM per_player) AS index_value FROM per_player), compared AS (SELECT player_id, bats, average_doubles, index_value, index_value - AVG(index_value) OVER (PARTITION BY bats) AS difference FROM indexed) SELECT player_id, bats, average_doubles, index_value, difference FROM compared WHERE bats IS NOT NULL ORDER BY difference IS NULL, difference DESC, player_id LIMIT 10;
